info.title: Sub Rosa account service
info.description: All browser mutations require exact Origin and the session-bound x-csrf-token header matching the subrosa_csrf cookie. Native bearer sessions do not use browser cookies. Cryptographic envelopes are strings containing opaque client ciphertext.

No session. What a reader learns before they have the key: how many pieces, how large, and until when. Never a title, a file name or an account
Read ordered encrypted changes below eight MiB per page

Admits browsers as devices (ADR 0096). Absent clears it; setting it on a version above 0 requires an authentication within five minutes.

Verify native passkey and return code for existing device exchange

delete.summary: Remove one passkey after recent browser authentication

post.summary: Vouch to Carpe Diem that this device may obtain its own key bound to jkt (ADR 0069, ADR 0096). The Carpe Diem key is never returned here
post.description: See docs/carpe-diem-partner-contract.md section 1. The assertion is an ES256 JWS, typ partner-assertion+jwt, valid 120 seconds, carried by the app to the Carpe Diem operator with a DPoP proof from the same ephemeral key. A browser device asks with its browser session and a subrosa-device-proof header bound to the request body, which holds jkt; it need not be recent, and its assertion carries kind browser and bound {daily_cap_credits, valid_seconds}. A browser session without a proof answers 403 device_required.

jkt.description: RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint of the app's ephemeral P-256 key, base64url without padding

403.description: device_required for a browser session, recent_auth_required when the session is older than 300 seconds

404.description: This deployment has no Carpe Diem partner configured

429.description: More than 5 assertions per minute for this account

parameters.name: subrosa-device-proof
parameters.description: Browser devices only. ES256 JWS, typ subrosa-device+jwt, signed by the browser's non-extractable P-256 device key. Claims htm, htu (public URL + path, exact), iat (within 60 s), jti (single use) and ath = base64url(SHA-256(the exact request body bytes)), on every route. The header carries kid = device id, or jwk = the public key when the device does not exist yet (ADR 0096).

post.summary: Make this browser a device of its account (ADR 0096)
post.description: Browser session with CSRF, authenticated within five minutes. The proof header carries the new device key as jwk. Admission is either a pairing request this browser session created and a live app approved within five minutes (consumed), or recovery_proof, the 32 bytes derived from the recovery key whose SHA-256 the vault holds as admission_verifier. 403 admission_required otherwise, 403 recent_auth_required for an old sign-in, 401 device_proof_invalid for a bad proof, 403 forbidden for an app session or past ten live browser devices.

parameters.name: subrosa-device-proof
parameters.description: ES256 JWS, typ subrosa-device+jwt, signed by the browser's non-extractable P-256 device key. Claims htm, htu (public URL + path, exact), iat (within 60 s), jti (single use) and ath = base64url(SHA-256(the exact request body bytes)), on every route. The header carries kid = device id, or jwk = the public key when the device does not exist yet (ADR 0096).

post.summary: The browser device signs itself out; no step-up. Its Carpe Diem key goes on the revocation outbox with reason signed_out

parameters.name: subrosa-device-proof
parameters.description: ES256 JWS, typ subrosa-device+jwt, signed by the browser's non-extractable P-256 device key. Claims htm, htu (public URL + path, exact), iat (within 60 s), jti (single use) and ath = base64url(SHA-256(the exact request body bytes)), on every route. The header carries kid = device id, or jwk = the public key when the device does not exist yet (ADR 0096).

get.summary: Everything this account made public (ADR 0097): profile, pages, sites and catalog listings, taken down or not, with the public origin

put.summary: Publish a note or a canvas as a page, or replace what it shows
put.description: The service renders the markdown to an allowlisted HTML fragment (raw HTML is shown as text, images keep only their description, links only http, https and mailto) and keeps that, plus a SHA-256 of title, a zero byte and the markdown. 409 slug_taken for an address another page holds, 409 conflict for another account's id or a second page from the same source_id. 422 content_policy names the rule refused (too_large, empty, control_characters, too_many_links, credential, blocked_term, shape, too_many; docs/public-content-rules.md). 403 taken_down for content the operator took down or an identical copy of it, 403 publishing_suspended after three takedowns. 404 when this deployment does not publish (ADR 0097).

delete.summary: Unpublish a page. Its text leaves the service at once. No step-up: it only takes away

put.summary: Set a site's title, home page and pages in navigation order
put.description: Every page must be a live page of this account, once. The home page defaults to the first. Pages that leave the site stay published on their own.

delete.summary: Delete a site; its pages stay published

put.summary: Create or update the opt-in public profile served at /u/{handle}
put.description: 409 slug_taken for a handle somebody holds; reserved handles are refused as shape. 422 content_policy names the rule refused (too_large, empty, control_characters, too_many_links, credential, blocked_term, shape, too_many; docs/public-content-rules.md). 403 taken_down for content the operator took down or an identical copy of it, 403 publishing_suspended after three takedowns. 404 when this deployment does not publish (ADR 0097).

put.summary: Set the profile picture: PNG, JPEG or WebP by its bytes, at most 256 KiB
Publish an assistant definition to the catalog, or replace it
put.description: permissions holds app tool keys only (web, image, video, music, speech, documents, notes, memory); a connector is refused. references are copies of text the publisher ticked, at most ten and 200 KiB. 422 content_policy names the rule refused (too_large, empty, control_characters, too_many_links, credential, blocked_term, shape, too_many; docs/public-content-rules.md). 403 taken_down for content the operator took down or an identical copy of it, 403 publishing_suspended after three takedowns. 404 when this deployment does not publish (ADR 0097).

delete.summary: Remove a listing from the catalog

get.summary: Search the public catalog. No session
get.description: Twenty-four per page, most imported first. q matches name or description as plain text.

get.summary: One live listing in full. No session

post.summary: The listing for Add to Sub Rosa, counted as one import. The import count is the only figure kept about readers. At most 10 a minute per address (429 slow_down), on top of the service-wide budget
Report public content. No session; one report per address and target

target.description: A page slug or a profile handle

get.summary: This account's identity for shared projects (ADR 0098): the self-signed public bundle and the private keys sealed under the vault key. 404 before one exists

put.summary: Publish the identity, compare-and-swap on expected_version. Refused (409) while the account belongs to any space

get.summary: The spaces this account is a member of

post.summary: Create a space at epoch 1 with its owner alone: the signed head and the epoch key sealed to the owner

get.summary: Members with their published bundles, every signed head, this member's sealed keys, pending departures, and for the owner the open invitations. 404 to anyone who is not a member

delete.summary: The owner deletes the space and everything in it

post.summary: Advance to the next epoch: a signed head naming the new members, one sealed key per member (and earlier keys for newcomers), and the claimed invitations admitted. The owner may change membership; another member may only rotate out members who left
The owner creates an invitation: the SHA-256 of the token the link derives, and the payload sealed under a key the link derives. At most seven days

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation that was not admitted yet

post.summary: A member who is not the owner leaves at once, with a statement signed for the current epoch

get.summary: Objects after a cursor, in the order the service accepted them. Query: after, limit (1 to 500)

post.summary: Append encrypted, signed objects under the current epoch only. A retried revision with the same bytes answers its first result; other bytes are a conflict
Any signed-in account with the token hash the link derives reads the sealed payload. 404 otherwise
Claim an invitation once: the caller's published bundle and an HMAC only the link can produce, which the owner's device verifies

kind.description: native for an app, browser for a browser admitted as a device (ADR 0096)

public_key.description: A browser device's P-256 public key (base64url coordinates), present for browser devices only, so the account's apps can check what that browser signed (ADR-0107 addendum)

SecurityEvent.description: One line of the account's security history. No network address, user agent or location is recorded.

device_name.description: The device label at the time of the event, when a device was involved.

ExpectedAccount.name: x-subrosa-account-id
ExpectedAccount.description: Client unlocked-account assertion, never an authorization source. A mismatch with the authenticated session returns 409 account_mismatch before data access.
